jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! You will also mentor colleagues, raise analytical standards, and help build a connected, high performing function.Who You Are:- You bring significant professional experience in geopolitical analysis, strategic intelligence, international affairs, government, diplomacy, public policy, or corporate strategy, with demonstrated expertise in major power relations and the global operating environment, including strong knowledge of the US, China, and the EU.- You have a proven track record of producing high-quality strategic assessments, scenarios, and executive level advice on complex, fast moving issues, with the ability to distinguish structural shifts from short term events.- You possess strong business acumen and understand how a diversified science and technology company creates value, makes decisions, and operates across markets; experience in healthcare, life science, electronics, semiconductors, or another regulated and technology intensive industry is strongly preferred.- You translate complexity into clear judgements, implications, options, and recommendations for senior leaders, bringing a rigorous, evidence-based point of view while making uncertainty and critical assumptions explicit.- You have excellent relationship building and influencing skills, with a track record of creating effective internal and external networks across functions, seniority levels, cultures, and geographies.- You are collaborative, intellectually curious, and willing to challenge assumptions constructively; you are comfortable working with ambiguity, incomplete information, and high-stakes issues while maintaining analytical rigor and discretion.- You communicate with excellence in written and verbal English; proficiency in additional languages relevant to major markets is an advantage.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!
